No. 2021/32– THURSDAY, JUNE, 01, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice Under Section 7 Reference No.: KDS/GIK/4/4/35. Land Ministry No.: 13/99/VE/259. THE Land Acquisition for construction of Reservoir, Dam, Site Premises & Quarry of Hydro Power Project of Moragolla, Gampola. I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land acquisition act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No: 28 of 1964, that the governments intends to acquire the following land/ servitude which is required for a public purpose:- Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The land allotments called Devalawatta, Ulapanewatta, Pitadeniyawatta, & Bogollawatta in total extent of about 5.2835 Hectares shown as lot Nos. 1-53 in plan No.Maha 6618 of 19.04.2017 depicted & prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village of Ulapane in Grama Niladhari Division of Ulapane South in Divisional Secretary Division of Ganga Ihala Korale in Kandy District, Central Province. (The list of particulars are attached)
